According to reports, affected employees have been asked to consider relocating to another country within IBM or leave the company. The decision could have a significant impact on Indian employees who have spent years building their careers and lives in the US.
But why has IBM taken this decision? Is it linked to the changing US immigration environment under Donald Trump? And what does it mean for the future of H-1B visa holders and Indian IT professionals?
In this explainer, we look at:
• How the decision could affect Indian employees working in America.
